description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the Cryptographer utility in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests to verify encryption and decryption functionalities of the Cryptographer class.

classes.name: CryptographerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Cryptographer utility's encryption and decryption methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer object with a specific key before each test.

methods.name: testEncrypt
methods.description: Tests that the encryption method produces the expected encrypted output.

methods.name: testDecrypt
methods.description: Tests that the decryption method correctly reverses the encryption.

methods.name: testEncryptDecrypt
methods.description: Verifies that encrypting and then decrypting a value results in the original value.
